name: Broken Bundle
summary: Bundle entry whose embedded marketplace.json fails the vendored marketplace.schema.json.
description: Used to test that bundle-entry.v1.schema.json's $ref to vendor/marketplace.schema.json rejects an embedded marketplace document missing its required fields (name, owner, plugins).

marketplace.description: This marketplace.json has no name, owner, or plugins field, all three of which vendor/marketplace.schema.json requires.
